qualifiers.reporting_period: calendar year ended December 31, 2025 unless a target or base year is explicitly named
qualifiers.ghg_calculation: sum 2025 gross Scope 1, gross market-based Scope 2 and gross Scope 3 in 1 000 tCO2e, then subtract the disclosed total gross market-based emissions
qualifiers.target_boundary: 2022 base year; Scope 1 and 2 and the four named Scope 3 focus categories remain distinct
qualifiers.water_boundary: preserve issuer assumptions, exemptions, inclusion rule and historical supplier-list qualification
qualifiers.safety_boundary: rates are per 200,000 work hours; third-party and contractor fatalities require occurrence at a Novartis site
qualifiers.access_boundary: preserve portfolio exclusions, estimation basis, possible multi-product double counting, sales threshold and UN geographic exclusions
qualifiers.assurance_boundary: limited assurance covers only Δ-marked 2025 information on the enumerated report pages; exclusions are separate atomic propositions
qualifiers.reference_type: simulated expert reference; not independent human gold
qualifiers.cloud_transmission: prohibited until user explicitly authorizes the Novartis report, exact pages, qwen3.5:397b-cloud and P15 Stage A/Stage B single-attempt scope
